name: focus-rotate
description: Configuration change. NOTE: `no reference event` is the EXPECTED result -- on the hardware measured so far rotation does NOT drop window focus. The activity is destroyed and recreated and the new window gains focus without the old one ever reporting a loss, so no focus=false is emitted and no flush fires. Kept as a regression guard: if a future platform version starts dropping focus on rotation, this row stops reading NONE.

steps.why: settle and let one foreground disk flush land as a positive control
rotate the device. Auto-rotate must be disabled first or user_rotation is ignored. Recreates the activity but does NOT produce a focus loss -- see description.
leave the device as found; mode reset also restores this
